en.title: Grounded Pose Library
en.summary: Camera-relative English pose clauses for 25 grounded seated/kneeling/lying poses in four fixed body sections; copy one clause as the pose slot of any image prompt
en.usage: Pick a pose id from assets/poses, copy its pre-rendered clause from examples/<id>/pose-clause.en.md, or bind the five slots from a pose spec

zh-CN.title: 贴地姿势库（25 个参考姿势）
zh-CN.summary: 面向坐/跪/卧姿势的四段式 camera-relative 英文姿势句库；单句直接复制进任意图像提示词的 pose 槽
zh-CN.usage: 从 assets/poses 选姿势，直接复制 examples/<id>/pose-clause.en.md，或按五槽位绑定编译
